name: Bed & Breakfast @ 4
suitableFor: Surfers, cyclists and couples wanting a small B&B
boardStorage: Secure shed for bikes and equipment; surfers welcome
confirmedFeatures: En-suite rooms, guest lounge with fridge, conservatory breakfast, free Wi-Fi, garden, secure shed
overview: Bed & Breakfast @ 4 is on Princes Street in central Thurso, about ten minutes' walk from the station. Its en-suite rooms are traditionally furnished, and guests have a lounge with a fridge and breakfast in the conservatory. The owners say surfers and cyclists are welcome.
surfTripFit: It openly welcomes surfers and has a secure shed for equipment, which is ideal for keeping boards safe between sessions.
